title: Third-party race-day recap: 2026 start waves and refreshment-station kilometre positions
claims: The recap lists 2026 start waves by predicted time: wheelchair about 7:55, elite women/men 8:00, priority 8:00, 3:00 wave 8:03, handisport 8:19, 3:15 8:22, 3:30 8:44, 3:45 9:34, 4:00 10:19, 4:15 11:10, 4:30 around 11:12, each with a separate corral entry time.

The recap places full food-and-liquid stations near km 4.8, 8.7, 13.3, 16.8, 21.3, 24.2, 30.6, 35.1 and 38.8, water-only points near 22.5, 29, 32.6 and 37, and electrolyte energy stations near 24.2 and 32.2.

These wave times and kilometre positions are a third-party recap of the official 2026 participant guide; the official guide PDF itself was not obtained for this check, so they are not treated as official-organiser figures.
